import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem parameterized_radical_root_product (t : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
   (ht₁ : t ≤ 1)
  (h₀ : ∀ x, f x = x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 30 + t) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)))
  (h₁ : Fintype (f ⁻¹' {0})) :
  (∏ x ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset, x) = 28 + t - 2 * Real.sqrt (16 - t) := by
  classical
  let s := Real.sqrt (16 - t)
  let c := 28 + t - 2 * s
  have ht_ge : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 16 - t := by linarith
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 16 - t := Real.sq_sqrt ht_ge
  have hs_pos : 0 < s + 1 := by linarith
  have hs_nonneg1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + s := by linarith
  have h_char : ∀ x, f x = 0 ↔ x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = 0 := by
    intro x
    have hfx : f x = x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 30 + t) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) := h₀ x
    have hfx_y : f x = (x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 45 - 15 + t) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 45) := by
      rw [hfx]; ring
    set y := x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 45 with hy_def
    have hy_eq : y = x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 45 := rfl
    have hc_eq : c = 28 + t - 2 * s := rfl
    constructor
    · intro hf0
      have h_eq_y : f x = y - 15 + t - 2 * Real.sqrt y := by rw [hfx_y, hy_eq]
      rw [h_eq_y] at hf0
      have h_y_nonneg : 0 ≤ y := by
        by_contra h_neg
        push_neg at h_neg
        have h_sqrt_zero : Real.sqrt y = 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt h_neg)
        have : y - 15 + t = 0 := by linarith
        linarith
      have h_sqrt_sq : Real.sqrt y ^ 2 = y := Real.sq_sqrt h_y_nonneg
      have h_eq : y - 15 + t = 2 * Real.sqrt y := by linarith
      have h_ge0 : 0 ≤ y - 15 + t := by
        have := Real.sqrt_nonneg y
        linarith
      have h_sq : (y - 15 + t) ^ 2 = 4 * y := by nlinarith
      have h_y1_eq : (1 + s) ^ 2 = 17 - t + 2 * s := by nlinarith [hs_sq]
      have h_y2_eq : (s - 1) ^ 2 = 17 - t - 2 * s := by nlinarith [hs_sq]
      have h_factor : (y - (17 - t + 2 * s)) * (y - (17 - t - 2 * s)) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hs_sq, h_sq]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_factor with h1 | h1
      · have hy1 : y = 17 - t + 2 * s := by linarith
        have : x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = y - 17 + t - 2 * s := by rw [hy_eq, hc_eq]; ring
        linarith
      · have hy2 : y = 17 - t - 2 * s := by linarith
        have : y - 15 + t = 2 - 2 * s := by linarith
        have : s > 1 := by nlinarith [hs_sq, sq_nonneg s, hs_nonneg]
        linarith
    · intro hqc
      have hy_eq1 : y = 17 - t + 2 * s := by
        have : x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = y - 17 + t - 2 * s := by rw [hy_eq, hc_eq]; ring
        linarith
      have hy_eq2 : y = (1 + s) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hs_sq, hy_eq1]
      have h_sqrt_y : Real.sqrt y = 1 + s := by
        rw [hy_eq2, Real.sqrt_sq hs_nonneg1]
      have h_eq_y : f x = y - 15 + t - 2 * Real.sqrt y := by rw [hfx_y, hy_eq]
      rw [h_eq_y, h_sqrt_y, hy_eq1]
      ring
  have h_set_eq : f ⁻¹' {0} = {x | x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = 0} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact h_char x
  have hD_nonneg : 0 ≤ 81 - c := by
    simp only [c, s]
    nlinarith [hs_nonneg, ht_ge, hs_sq, Real.sqrt_nonneg (16 - t)]
  have hD_pos : 0 < 81 - c := by
    simp only [c, s]
    nlinarith [hs_nonneg, ht_ge, hs_sq, Real.sqrt_nonneg (16 - t)]
  let D := 81 - c
  have hD_def : D = 81 - c := rfl
  let u := Real.sqrt D
  have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hu_sq : u ^ 2 = D := Real.sq_sqrt hD_nonneg
  have hu_pos : 0 < u := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos hD_pos
  let r1 : ℝ := -9 + u
  let r2 : ℝ := -9 - u
  have hr_ne : r1 ≠ r2 := by
    simp only [r1, r2]
    linarith
  have h_quad_iff : ∀ x, x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = 0 ↔ x = r1 ∨ x = r2 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : x ^ 2 + 18 * x + c = (x + 9) ^ 2 - D := by
      simp only [D, hD_def]; ring
    have h2 : (x + 9) ^ 2 - D = (x + 9 - u) * (x + 9 + u) := by nlinarith [hu_sq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h3 : (x + 9) ^ 2 = D := by linarith [h1, h]
      have h4 : (x + 9 - u) * (x + 9 + u) = 0 := by nlinarith [h3, hu_sq]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h4 with h5 | h5
      · left; simp only [r1]; linarith
      · right; simp only [r2]; linarith
    · intro h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl
      · have : r1 + 9 = u := by simp only [r1]; ring
        nlinarith [hu_sq, this, h1]
      · have : r2 + 9 = -u := by simp only [r2]; ring
        nlinarith [hu_sq, this, h1]
  have h_set_eq2 : f ⁻¹' {0} = {r1, r2} := by
    ext x
    rw [h_set_eq]
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact h_quad_iff x
  have h_finset_eq : (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset = {r1, r2} := by
    ext x
    have h_mem_toFinset : x ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset ↔ x ∈ f ⁻¹' {0} := Set.mem_toFinset
    rw [h_mem_toFinset, h_set_eq2]
    simp
  have h_prod_pair : ∏ x ∈ ({r1, r2} : Finset ℝ), x = r1 * r2 :=
    Finset.prod_pair hr_ne
  have h_r_prod : r1 * r2 = c := by
    simp only [r1, r2]
    nlinarith [hu_sq, hD_def]
  calc ∏ x ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset, x = ∏ x ∈ ({r1, r2} : Finset ℝ), x := by
        rw [h_finset_eq]
    _ = r1 * r2 := h_prod_pair
    _ = c := h_r_prod
    _ = 28 + t - 2 * Real.sqrt (16 - t) := rfl
